items.summary: Paula D. talks to Don and Sam about helping two elderly AA members connect with AA meetings during the height of the Covid 19 pandemic. Paula's story appears in the December 2021 issue of Grapevine. She also shares two key actions to being published in the Grapevine.

items.title: Miracles Across Time Zones [Season 1, Episode 9]
items.summary: Don and Sam interview Terrie and her friend from the Australian Outback, Jennie, about the wonders of sobriety.

items.title: What's in a Name?—The Ashville Wharf Rats [Season 1, Episode 8]
items.summary: Don and Sam interview Chris C. about maintaining sober traction in slippery situations.

items.title: Completely Whipped [Season 1, Episode 7]
items.summary: Don and Sam interview Phillip from North Carolina about moving from fear to trust in AA.

items.title: Getting Comfortable with the Second Step [Season 1, Episode 6]
items.summary: Don and Sam talk to Cindy from Virginia about her early struggles with a higher power. Special feature "Hashtag Heard in a Meeting" debuts in this episode.

items.title: AA "Pen" Pals with Tom Z. [Season 1, Episode 5]
items.summary: Tom Z. describes his experience of helping incarcerated AA members through correspondence. In "Blast from the Past, " Bill W. recalls pacing the lobby of the Mayflower Hotel and his realization that he needed to speak with another alcoholic.

items.title: God Talk [Season 1, Episode 4]
items.summary: Don and Sam interview old-time Ritch, and play "Stump the Thumpers" with Melanie.

items.title: 186 Home Groups [Season 1, Episode 3]
items.summary: Don and Sam interview A.J., who at 8 months sober hit the road to visit every meeting in his Midwest city.

items.title: Behind the Curtain, with Josh E. of the AA General Service Board [Season 1, Episode 2]
items.summary: Don and Sam interview Josh E., a General Service Board Trustee and current Chair of the AA Grapevine Board of Directors.

items.title: Who Are We? Featuring Michael M. [Season 1, Episode 1]
items.summary: Don and Sam introduce themselves to Grapevine podcast listeners. Michael M. from New York is this episode's guest. Michael's story, We Showed Them, is featured in the October 2021 issue of Grapevine magazine.

shows.description: AA members Don, Olis and Sam interview other AA members about their experience, strength, and hope in recovering from alcoholism. Expect both humor and inspiration as these AA members share their stories.

shows.name: Grapevine Weekly Open AA Meeting
shows.title: Grapevine Weekly Open AA Meeting
shows.description: Each week AA Grapevine holds an open virtual AA meeting with a host and two speakers. We record the meeting to create this podcast.
